notes.title: Fixed Ammo bug
notes.content:
* Bug where some ammo for the gun wouldn't work correctly.

Turns out the tag list for the different kinds of ammo was corrupted in the last update. This made it so that all ammos had the same damage, as well as completely failing to trigger some of the easter eggs in the game. This should be fixed now.

notes.title: SYLVIO UPDATE
notes.content:
Important stuff first:


 Added the ability to Run.
 Added Custom Key Binding.
 Rearranged the gameplay in the second level, to make it more intuitive.
 Took away the combination lock function on all lockers. I've always seen it as a feature creep, and it makes the game unplayable for deaf players. 
 Killed some long-living bugs. 
 Various cosmetica.


It's been five years since the last update. The release of Sylvio 2 caused me to burn out of gamedev I got back into working as a freelance composer, I co-founded an environmental startup, coded some apps. In 2021 I dipped my toe into gamedev again, with a project called Guidance.

In the beginning of 2022, I got invited to join the Dread X Collection 5, a horror game collection put together by Dread XP. I had roughly two months to put together a game with a playtime of 45 minutes. 
Man, it was so intense, to just go from scratch zero to finished project in that short amount of time, but it was an amazing experience.

You can get the collection here. The game I made is called KARAO.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1899810/Dread_X_Collection_5/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8831055/3fab6bae03115027502c924953113bb0548049fe.png

The experience made me relearn what it is I love about creating horror games. I am currently exploring paths for future horror game projects, and will keep you posted when something materialises. Guidance is put on hold for the moment.

Digging up the old Sylvio project and getting into that spaghetti code has been cleansing, in a way. I'm so thankful for all the people that have been playing it through the years, and as it's still being picked up by new players, it feels good to give it an update.

As always, let me know of any bugs, either on the forum or on bugs@stroboskop.com

If you have any problem with the new build, you can use the password Play2017Sylvio to access the old build. 

See you soon,
Niklas, Stroboskop

notes.title: Guidance : A new survival horror game from the creator of Sylvio
notes.content:
Guidance is a survival horror game about spirit possession.

Play as Velvet, a golden-ager in search of his lost wife. Talk to spirits through the possessed, tranquillize the angry ones, and try to ignore those blackouts you're having.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41429091/4f6242e0000cc9ab74bf1f10f345c113afbf7f23.gif

Velvet, a senior citizen and retired electrician, is on a guided bus tour far out in the wilderness with his wife Jo. Coming across an old abandoned village, the guide decides to go off the planned schedule and take the group for a short improvised exploration. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41429091/1df659766f571d8c8f9c04fcfe7dd299cac69500.gif

Velvet, who chose to stay behind for a nap, wakes up alone several hours later in the dark bus. Equipped only with a tranquilizer gun he enters the village, determined to find his wife. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41429091/8caff406c0d23f22d6d0146a8b4ed0898e97418e.gif

Velvet communicates with the spirits that have possessed the other people from the group. His one and only concern is finding his wife, and will take any steps necessary in order to make that happen. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41429091/59eab8ada7c49a56843c390653215669f160f04a.gif

He doesn't care about the well-being of the other ones from the group. If they're a threat to his mission, or if they  turn up to be useful in some way, Velvet will take actions accordingly.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41429091/af79955c3fb4e5dbf23c50fed9a923b0f77fbd04.gif

The zoom-out seen in the trailer is a part of gameplay. You are able to fully zoom in and out during the game, to spot areas of interest or to plan your next move. Zooming in will reveal details around you, but might put you in danger of surprise attacks.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41429091/44fe3cb4d1381ff78270fd5a80a383e63745631e.gif

Explore a meticulously detailed, boarded-up, abandoned village, overtaken by wild grass and moths. The street lights are triggered with motion detectors. This is your only source of light, and can be a good way to spot the others, before they spot you.

Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1797400

notes.title: Update - Achievement glitch
notes.content:
I've received some reports on some of the achievements not working correctly. 

Thanks for reporting it, sorry about the delay in getting it fixed. I'd like to blame some problems with the original project files (which I had), but the truth is I've been swamped with the developing of Sylvio 2. 

Now however, you should receive any and all achievements you are entitled to when entering the start page. Just let it sit for a couple of seconds while it goes through your save data.

Let me know if there are any issues with this (or anything else) at bugs@sylviogame.com 

Thanks!

Niklas

notes.title: A major update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I've been away from Steam the last months, as I've been buried with porting Sylvio to PS4 and XBox One. Apologies for not hanging out in the forums as much as I use to. I've been answering e-mails though, and that's really the best way to get in contact. 
niklas@stroboskop.com if you want to say hi or bugs@sylviogame.com if you're having troubles.

Sylvio is being released on PS4 and XBox One Friday 13th, January 2017. During the porting I added some features like revisiting areas, nicer hand animations and a bunch of other stuff, and this update adds all of that to the PC and Mac version.

There’s been a lot of work done on optimizing the levels, and things should just run smoother over-all.

I have deleted two achievements, Photo Of The Face and Blood Of The Mist, because they didn’t make sense with the new ’revisit area’-function. 

That’s all for now, take care and if you run into any bugs, I’m very grateful if you let me know at bugs@sylviogame.com

Best,
Niklas

notes.title: New patch - Disappearing Orbs
notes.content:
I've been fighting for a while with a bug where the black orbs from time to time becomes invisible. I've been in contact with the 3rd party developers who made the plugin I'm using, but no solution has yet been found.

At first I thought it was an obscure problem only appearing on macs - but it seems like a few players are experiencing it all the time on all platforms - which makes the issue a lot more alarming.

I've now scrapped the 3rd party plugin and built a variation of the orb natively in Unity. Hopefully this will eliminate any problems. The patch is now live.

Thank you!

//Niklas

notes.title: Trading Cards and Update!
notes.content:
Some of you have been requesting this from the very beginning, so I'm very happy to finally release a set of Sylvio Trading Cards, Emoticons, Badges and Backgrounds. Hope you like them. 

New in the latest update:

Reset car! If the car gets stuck or rolls over, exit the car and hold action button while looking at it. 
Achievements Sheet no 5 and Piano Player were broken and are now fixed.
Various bugs and issues fixed. If you're wondering about something in particular, mail me at bugs@sylviogame.com

notes.title: Invert Y-axis, smoothness on / off, right hand key mapping
notes.content:
It's been a busy first week since the launch! A couple of requests from players has comed up, and in the latest update I've been able to cater some of them. You are now able to:

* Invert Y-axis 
* Turn camera smoothness on / off
* Play with right hand key mapping

The added keys are:

E (action) = Num 0
Q (cancel) = Delete
C (flashlight) = Page down
1-9 (mic, gun, inventory, reel recorder, sheet 1-5) = Num 1-9
Space (jump) = Shift

If you find any bugs, or whatever strange thing that might occur, please send a mail to bugs@sylviogame.com . I am very curious about your problems, and eager to eliminate them in the following updates. We'll keep in touch and  thanks for playing!

Niklas Swanberg
